Against the end goal nothing has moved - BASELINE_HONEST still does not exist, H9 and H10 are still unresolved, and c-0002.1, the only item on the board with an irreversible deadline, has spent a day of the fifteen left before the 1-minute bar window closes around 2026-09-18. items.title: The queue is not being consumed - 26 hours, no commit, and every open work order is pull-blocked
items.why: Every route to the end goal runs through the critical path 1a to 2 to 3, and all three of its live work orders (c-0001.2, c-0002.1, c-0002.2) are pull-based: they move only when a Claude Code session runs review.py next, and Cowork cannot start one. Ordinarily an idle day costs nothing but a day. Here it does not, because c-0002.1 is the one item on the board that expires: yfinance serves 1-minute bars for roughly thirty days and the dense intraday era begins 2026-08-19, so after about 2026-09-18 the intraday clock anchor cannot be measured at minute resolution at all, and Phase 6 - the timing study the whole end goal resolves to - would have to be built on an unproven join between two clock domains. That is precisely the shape of error rule 9 exists to stop: a one-bar offset does not degrade a real effect, it manufactures a clean spurious one that passes every test in the repo.
items.acceptance: data/review/inbox.jsonl gains a start, blocked or done event on c-0002.1 posted by claude-code, and git log shows a commit after 5844a4e. Failing that, an explicit defer or reject on c-0002.1 from Andrew recording that the intraday anchor will not be measured before the window closes - so Phase 6 inherits an unproven origin knowingly rather than by drift.
items.estimate: 5m to start a session; c-0002.1 itself is the work
